description: Return the RENDERED text of the page under test, or of a single element named by a qa_snapshot ref or a CSS selector. This is the companion to qa_snapshot: that one maps what you can ACT on (roles, names, refs) and caps every name at 80 characters, so anything longer — a one-time code in an email, an error paragraph, a generated invoice number — is invisible to it. Uses innerText, so hidden branches and a mail thread's collapsed quoted history stay out. Read-only: it executes nothing and returns text, capped (default 4000 chars, max 20000).

frameId.description: Which frame to ask, from qa_frames. Omit for the page itself. A payment form, an SSO step or an embedded widget usually lives in a frame of its own, and a cross-origin one can only be read from inside it.

ref.description: A ref from qa_snapshot (e.g. "e12") — preferred when you already have one

selector.description: CSS selector; omit both to read the whole page body

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_read
title: Read the text of a page (or one element)
